source_text: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ⸂[ἐν Ἐφέσῳ]⸃ καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
english_snapshot: Paul[a], an apostle of Messiah Jesus by the will of God[c][b], to the saints who are [in Ephesus] and faithful in Messiah Jesus:

signals.text: Some early manuscripts omit 'in Ephesus,' which has led some to understand this letter as intended for a wider circulation rather than only for the church in Ephesus.

source_text: εἷς θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ πάντων, ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν ⸀πᾶσιν.
english_snapshot: one God and Father of all[b][a], who is over all and through all and in all.

signals.text: Or 'in everyone.' Some manuscripts read 'in you all.'

source_text: ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ ⸀φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ,
english_snapshot: for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth[c][b][a],

signals.text: Some manuscripts read “the fruit of the Spirit” instead of “the fruit of the light.”

english_snapshot: because we are members of his body[a].

signals.text: Some manuscripts add, 'of his flesh and of his bones.'
